exposure: pregnancy complications (preeclampsia, gestational diabetes, placental disorders)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 152,246 women aged 18-50 years with singleton live births in Alberta, Canada, between 2014 and 2017.
finding: Advanced maternal age (>=35 years) modified the association between preeclampsia and preterm birth (sPTB and iPTB), showing that older women with preeclampsia have a higher risk for preterm birth.
gest_age: Outcome defined as birth before 37 weeks of gestation.
